messages:
maya: Pulled a visibility-playback for tenant=acme. Route matching looked inconsistent between decision logs and the live trace. trace_id=8a3f77cc. Console snapshot: https://console.redwood.ai/traces/8a3f77cc
kevin: Can you paste the decision_log entry? sampling might've dropped headers. what's the routing sampling % for acme?
maya: Decision log shows MATCH on route 'acme-prefix' but headers in trace show `x-tenant: acme-v2`. Decision log header is `x-tenant: acme`. suspicious. snippet: ```decision_log: {route: "acme-prefix", headers:{"x-tenant":"acme"}} trace_headers: {"x-tenant":"acme-v2","x-env":"prod"}```
sam: If sampling happens before normalization, header casing/normalization could mismatch. we had a prior bug where normalizer ran after sampler.
zara: Try playback with full decision logs for that window. Console has a `visibility_playback` toggle but it's off by default. CLI: `redwoodctl playback --tenant acme --trace 8a3f77cc --full-decision-logs`
deploy-bot: playback job queued (job id pb-1725839234).
kevin: I can drop a short-lived override: bump route eval sampling to 10% for acme for 30m. Will add a correlator tag to link trace <-> decisionlog. Proposed patch: ```- name: acme-prefix
  sample_rate: 0.1
  tags: [visibility_playback]```
lee: :+1: Do it. Also add rule to log original headers before normalization: `log_raw_headers: true`
maya: If we enable that, will it log user PII? Need privacy check.
zara: We already have a PII sanitizer. I'll ensure redaction rules include `email,ip,acct_id` before dumping raw_headers to S3.
deploy-bot: playback job pb-1725839234 started at 1725839250, found 12 correlated requests.
kevin: Patch applied in canary, sampling bumped. I'll post the rollout link.
kevin: Rollout: https://console.redwood.ai/rollouts/roll-4042 (canary=5 hosts)
maya: Observed 3 mismatched entries now captured with correlator=vp-4042. Looks like the normalization hook was run in a different order on gateway-3 causing header rewrite.
sam: Root cause: gateway-3 had old image missing the header-normalizer middleware. Fix: rebuild gateway image and redeploy.
zara: I'll schedule redeploy to gateway-3, and keep sampling up for 1h.
lee: Also add a dashboard card to show header-normalizer health across pods -> Prod.
maya: Thanks all. I'll open a short incident note with artifacts + mark for postmortem if needed.
